eyebrow: JSON_VALUE: one scalar value, by path
caption: Dots walk down into nested objects to one plain value.

eyebrow: A non-scalar path: NULL, not an error
code:
SELECT JSON_VALUE(@Json, '$.Tags') AS AttemptOnArray;
-- Returns NULL -- $.Tags is an array, not a scalar
caption: JSON_VALUE only ever returns a single scalar value.

code:
SELECT JSON_QUERY(@Json, '$.Tags') AS TagsArray,
       JSON_QUERY(@Json, '$.Vendor') AS VendorObject;
caption: Built for exactly the case JSON_VALUE can't handle.

eyebrow: Both together, against real query output
caption: FOR JSON out, JSON_VALUE back in -- the chapter's toolkit, together.

subtitle: Building queries out of other queries.
